rules.statement: A plaintiff is not entitled to maintain an action quia timet against a defendant who has merely purchased the right and title of a judgment-debtor at a Fiscal's sale, without obtaining a Fiscal's transfer.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think the act of the defendant in buying at the Fiscal's sale amounted either to a 'denial' of the plaintiffs' rights or the 'infliction of an affirmative injury' on them."
